content: Pablo, Corintoʼgi gudigusad
Geb a-sorba, Pablo Atenasʼgi bangudsunnad, Corinto-neggweburse nadegusad.

A-neggweburgi Judío-wargwen-abingualid, Aquilaʼye nugad. A-dulede, Ponto-yalaginedid. Na-e-ome-Priscila-ebo Italia-yargi-mai emissaar nonimalad. Ar Roma-saila-Claudioʼye-nugad, igar-mesisad, bela Judíoʼmar-Roma-neggweburgi-gudimalad ainioye. Pablo, Aquilaʼse ataknad gusad.
Ar we-dulemarde, Pabloʼyob dordoneg-makedgi arbamogad. Degisoggu, Pablo amar-walik bessunnad, adi, na amarbo dordoneg-makedgi arbaegar.
Obunnoged-ibagi Pablo Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse Judíoʼmarga-sunmakega, degi, Judíoʼsurmaladga-sunmakega naddaed. Adi, Bab-Jesús-igarba nagumalagar.

Silas, Timoteo-ebo Macedonia-yargi-mai Pabloʼse nonimargua, Pablo Bab-Jesús-gayaburbaginbi Judíoʼmarga-sunmakega alamakdii guarsunnad. Judíoʼmarga sogdii gualid, we-Jesús, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-anmarga-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sunnadye.

Judíoʼmar Pablo-sunmaked gwen nabir itossurmalad, egi oimakarmalad, ukabsaarmarbalid. Agi Pablo e-mor mor-mor imaksad. A sogleged, an bemarga Bab-Jesús-igargi-sunmakdiid wesesunnoye. Geb Pablo sogded: “Andi bato bemarga Jesús-igargi sunmaksando, emigindi, bemarginsundo. Ar Bab-Dummad sabsur-bemar-odurdakarmalale, dukin be samarsunnodo. Emigindi, Judíoʼsurmaladga Bab-Jesús-igargi an sunmaknasunnoed.”
Pablo Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi nodgu, Justo-negse naded. A-negde, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-nagaba siid. Justoʼde nue Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadimogad-duled.

Degi, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-e-dummad-Crispoʼye-nugadi, degi, bela e-neg-yaurginmalad Bab-Jesúsʼgi bensuli gunonimalad. Deginbali, bukidar Corintoʼginmalad Bab-Jesús-igar itoarmargu, Bab-Jesúsʼgi bensuli gunonimogad, degine, Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi oglesmarbalid.
Ibagwengi neg-mutikidba Pablo negburgan dakalid. Agi Bab-Jesús Pabloʼga sunmaknonikid, ega sognonikid: “Mer be dobguo, gatik an-gayaburba-nuedgi be sunmako, mer bogilego.
Ar an beba gudiguad, degisoggu, dule gwen be-oakalogosulid. Ar ade, we-neggweburgi dulemar-bukidar-anba-nagumaloed an nikad.”
Degisoggu, Pablo Corinto-neggweburgi birgagwen-abala megisad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi dulemar-odurdakdii gusad.
Deunni, Galión Acaya-neggweburgi sailaga-maid-ibagi, Judíoʼmar bular Pabloʼgi gwisguar gusmalad, igar-nabiroged-negse Pablo-sesmalad.
Galiónʼga sokarmalad: —We-dule, igar-maisulidba Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega aimar-binsaed gadiiye.
Pablo nue sunmaksokali, Galión Judíoʼmarga sogded: —Ar emi we-dule neg-oakalodina, degi, igar-mamaidgi dummad-gwisgudiina, an nue be itosmalardo.

Emigindi, unnila gayaginbi ibmar-sogdiid, degi, dule-nugmarginbi sunmakdiid, aginbali, bemar-igar-mamaidginbi sunmakdiid. Degisoggu, we-igar na be dukin nabiromardo. Andi we-igar bemarga nabirogosulid.
Degi, Galiónʼdi igar-nabiroged-neggi Judíoʼmar-bukwad onidsunnad.
Degi, bela dulemar, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-e-dummad-Sóstenesʼye-nugad gasmargu, Galión-wagab sarsosmalad. Degite, Dummad-Galión Sóstenes-sarsolesad gwen bai daksasulid.
Pablo, Siriaʼgi Antioquía-siidse gannar aligusad

Pablo amba ibbigbasaar Corintoʼgi megialid. A-sorba, gwenadgan-Jesúsʼba-nanaimaladga napi-sunmas, egi bangudsunnad. Degimaloye, gwenadganga-sogsad-sorba, Pablo, Aquilaʼmala, degi, Priscilaʼmala, Cencrea-neggweburse armalad. Cencreaʼse-nonigu, Pablo sailagia na gwiri siksad. A oyoged: Bab-Dummadga napira na ibmar-saoye-sogsadi, an imakedseye. Degi, Cencrea-akar urgi Siria-yarse armarsunnad. Aquila, degi, Priscila, Pabloʼba aligusmarmogad.
Éfeso-neggweburse modapmargu, Pablo, a-neggweburgi, Priscilaʼgi, degi, Aquilaʼgi bachikgusad. Edi Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse naded. Agi Jesús-igargi Judíoʼmar-bukwamaladga sunmakdapid.
Judíoʼmar egi wilenaigusmalad, wis be wegi ibbigbasaar anmar-walik megye. Pabloʼdi yapa begusad.

Degi, Pablo amargi bangudgu, sogded: “Iba-danikid-daknaega an Jerusalén-neggweburse naergebed. Andi bemar-dakega gannar bemarse dagbiendo, Bab-Dummadbi wissundo, an gannar bemarse danibalodibe.” Pablo Éfesoʼgi-mai urgi arsunnad.
Pablo Cesareaʼse modapgu, Jerusalénʼse nadegusad, adi, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad wis daknaegar. A-sorba, geb Antioquíaʼse nadsunnad.
Pablo a-neggweburgi undar-megedgi, bela Galacia-yargi, degi, Frigia-yargi-neggweburmar-bukmaladse gwenadgan-daknad gusbalid. Agi Pablo gwenadgan-ogannodii gusad.
Apolos, Éfesoʼgi Bab-Jesús-igargi sunmaksad
A-ibagangi Éfeso-neggweburse Judío-wargwen nonikid, Apolosʼye nugad. A-dulede, Alejandría-neggweburgi gwalulesad. Apolosʼde yeer sunmaked, degi, Bab-Dummad-Garda nue wisbalid.
A-dulede, Bab-Jesús-igar-maidgi nue-odurdaklesad, degisoggu, nue-yeer aimar-odurdakdimosundo. Unnila Juan-diigi-ogleged-igarbi-wisin-inigwele, ise-sanagwar aimarga Jesúsʼgi sunmakdii gusad.

Apolos, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi nue-gandikidba, dobsuli aimarga sunmaksad. Priscila, Aquila-ebo Apolos-sunmaked itosmargu, sorba bachikii Apolos-sesagusmalad. Geb degi, Apolosʼga Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid nue osanalosmalad.

A-sorba, Apolos Acaya-yarse naesokargu, gwenadgan Apolos-ogannosmalad, ega garda narmakar barmismalad, adi, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad weba nued abingamalagar. Apolos, Acayaʼse modapgu, nue Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-bendakdapid. A-gwenadgande, abonolege-wilubsulinad, degi-inigwele, Bab-Jesúsʼgi abonolesmalad.

Apolos gwenadgan-nue-bendakdapid, ar ade, bela dulemar-abargi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-naidba Judíoʼmarga nue-oyosad, we-Jesúsʼde, Cristo-sunnadye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye. Degisoggu, Judíoʼmar geg abinsae gusmalad.
